units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 48b:13">Snh. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>לְטוּתֵיה דלַטְיֵיה אבוך</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 172">Yalk. Kings 172</cite> <cite ref="L00215"><he>לַוְוטָתָא</he></cite>) his curse with which thy father cursed him (euphemism for: the curse with which thy father cursed me).
<cite ref="Niddah 13b:42">Nidd. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>דינא תנן או ל׳ תנן</he> does the Mishnah (<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:1">Nidd. II, 1</cite>) mean a law (punishment) or an execration?
